revenueNote: Reported revenue snapshots, not a verified portfolio total. October 8 checks: Redbubble no sales; Legiit Total Earnings $0; Buy Me a Coffee last-30-day earnings $0; RapidAPI Total Paid $0.00 for May-October. Paid-subscriber count is unverified. Payhip was last checked October 5; later activity is unknown. Other platform revenue remains unverified.
tldr: The invoice API, fourteen calculators, Redbubble designs and Payhip’s $5 pack have public pages, with no confirmed sales in the checked records. Redbubble sales history showed no sales on October 8; RapidAPI shows Total Paid $0.00 in its displayed six-month analytics, while paid-subscriber count remains unverified. Payhip checkout is disabled; calculators now link to Buy Me a Coffee, which still cannot take support. Redbubble’s camper design now has a public product page, but its shop grid is still empty; TeePublic publishing is parked after repeated crashes. All three Legiit services now show ACTIVE with no pending-approval label: retro art ($15), calculator ($20) and invoice generator ($25). Legiit marketplace discovery and buyer checkout are unverified. Stripe and GitHub Sponsors are building; Adobe and Etsy are blocked; Fiverr and Truelancer are parked. HackerOne and Bugcrowd account setup is complete; security bounty research is building, with no reports or awards yet.
